title: workspaces.check_mandate
description: Does this user hold a mandate ANYWHERE — an accepted, non-suspended membership in a workspace that is not soft-deleted? Workspace-agnostic on purpose: the two other providers are workspace-scoped, so neither can tell a guest (a real account belonging to nothing) from a member. False is a verdict; an unreachable provider is not, and callers turn that into 503. Returns {has_mandate: bool}.
